description: Signature-aware comparison already suppresses persistent-red duplicates. The residual gap is first-failure attribution: a latent environment-dependent break can still open a revert against the first red post-merge SHA even when that PR did not touch the failing test. Add a guard that maps the failing test to the blamed PR diff; if the test file and its code-under-test are untouched, downgrade the revert to an advisory comment. Preserve the existing signature comparison and do not disable auto-revert for true same-subsystem first failures.
